title: Place every interlocking artifact under plan/_trains/_interlockings/

facts.note: Canonical interlocking home and registry index paths.
Plan/task text concerns an interlocking artifact.
subject_kind: interlocking. Recognising interlocking artifacts anywhere in the plan (including outside the canonical home) needs a content-based classifier, not just a path glob.
Validator runs at CONFIRM over every interlocking artifact in the plan (new and existing) and blocks confirmation; a workflow-phase observer is needed.

fires: A plan reaches CONFIRM and contains any interlocking artifact, new or pre-existing
An interlocking artifact is authored, edited, moved or exists somewhere other than under plan/_trains/_interlockings/
An interlocking artifact under plan/_trains/_interlockings/ has no entry in plan/_trains/_interlockings.yaml
doesNotFire: A plan that contains no interlocking artifacts
Plan artifacts whose subject kind is not interlocking (e.g. wagons, WMBTs, acceptances) when no interlocking is present

given: A plan contains, or is gaining, interlocking artifacts (new or existing); placement is enforced at CONFIRM, so it applies from the moment the interlocking is authored
when: The planner authors, edits or moves an interlocking artifact, or brings a plan containing one to CONFIRM
then: Every interlocking artifact lives under plan/_trains/_interlockings/.
prefer: Place interlocking files under plan/_trains/_interlockings/ when first authoring them, rather than relocating them at CONFIRM
Ensure each interlocking under the home has an entry in the registry index plan/_trains/_interlockings.yaml (separate registration obligation, see splitSuggestion)
avoid: Placing interlocking artifacts next to wagons, trains or in other plan folders outside plan/_trains/_interlockings/
Leaving an interlocking artifact unregistered in plan/_trains/_interlockings.yaml
why: Other interlocking rules (registry mirroring, guards, payloads, route resolution, route-space admission) presuppose the homed and registered interlocking set; an artifact outside the home or registry is invisible to them.
evidence: On failure the finding reports interlocking_id, path, expected_home and actual_home
verifier_detail: validation.family: presence; template: required_field_presence; variant: planner_train_interlocking_home
failure_evidence fields: interlocking_id, path, expected_home, actual_home
expected_home = plan/_trains/_interlockings/ (any path beneath it satisfies placement); registry index = plan/_trains/_interlockings.yaml (each interlocking must be registered there)
audit: term_id: interlocking_home — 'interlocking artifacts live under plan/_trains/_interlockings/ with a registry index at plan/_trains/_interlockings.yaml'
statement: Interlocking artifacts live under plan/_trains/_interlockings/ and are registered in plan/_trains/_interlockings.yaml.

splitSuggestion.then: Every interlocking artifact has an entry in the registry index plan/_trains/_interlockings.yaml.

additions.text: Other interlocking rules presuppose the homed and registered interlocking set; an artifact outside the home or registry is invisible to them.
additions.justification: Source has no reason text; derived from graph.json 'requires' edge reasons.

additions.text: Source statement combines two independently satisfiable requirements: placement under plan/_trains/_interlockings/ (kept in then) and registration in plan/_trains/_interlockings.yaml (kept in prefer[1]/avoid[1]/verifier_detail[5]; proposed separate convention planner.train.interlocking-registered). Both currently share one validator and term interlocking_home.
additions.justification: Rule 2: one obligation per then; auditor requested separate traceability.
Required by schema; derived from statement, subject_kind: interlocking and phase: CONFIRM.

additions.text: Place at first authoring rather than relocating at CONFIRM
additions.justification: Timing clarification only (reviewer usability risk): the CONFIRM-blocking check applies to all interlockings, so placing them correctly from authoring avoids a blocked confirmation; adds no new obligation.

additions.text: any path beneath it satisfies placement
additions.justification: Restates source 'under' (not 'directly under') so nested artifacts are not rejected; reviewer usability risk.
